DEPOSIT £1988 - One bedroom furnished property in Edinburgh. TO BOOK A VIEWING ONLINE, PLEASE FILL IN THE CONTACT AGENT FORM.

Tastefully decorated this contemporary main door property comprises bright and airy open planned living area with floor to ceiling windows offering stunning views of the canal, a fully equipped, high spec kitchen, double bedroom with built in wardrobe and modern luxurious shower room. The property further benefits from gas central heating, double glazing and storage. 

Set in the desirable Viewforth area close to excellent local amenities and within walking distance of the City Centre. Fountain Park Leisure Centre is also just moments away which includes restaurants, cinema, gym and bowling complex. There are excellent bus links providing quick and easy access to the City Centre and surrounding areas.
